title: ThinkingGuard: Decoding Implicit Hazards via Step-by-Step Risk Attribution in Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.36562v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in safety-critical domains, their reliability is threatened by multimodal implicit risks. Unlike explicit threats, these hazards emerge when individually benign text and neutral visual entities logically converge to induce unsafe outputs. Current detection methods fail to address this because they overlook the underlying risk activation mechanisms that govern cross-modal risk activation, leading to single-modality shortcut learning and hallucinated rationalizations. To bridge this gap, we first construct TriggerBench, the first dataset explicitly modeling risk compositionality (5,600 instances). translated_title: ThinkingGuard：在多模态大语言模型中通过逐步风险归因解码隐式危害
translated_abstract: 虽然多模态大语言模型（MLLM）越来越多地被部署在安全关键领域，但其可靠性正受到多模态隐式风险的威胁。与显式威胁不同，这类危害是在单独无害的文本与中性的视觉实体在逻辑上汇聚并诱发不安全输出时产生的。当前的检测方法未能解决这一问题，因为它们忽视了支配跨模态风险激活的底层机制，从而导致单模态捷径学习和幻觉式的合理化解释。为弥合这一差距，我们首先构建了TriggerBench——首个显式建模风险组合性的数据集（包含5,600个实例）。通过正式地分离关键要素与触发要素来构建反事实对比对，TriggerBench消除了风险残留，迫使模型进行真正的逻辑推演而非表面的模式匹配，从而为该任务提供了一个严谨的基础。
tldr: 该论文提出了ThinkingGuard框架，通过逐步风险归因来解码多模态大语言模型中的隐式跨模态风险，并构建了首个显式建模风险组合性的数据集TriggerBench（含反事实对比对），以解决现有检测方法中单模态捷径学习与幻觉式合理化的问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes ThinkingGuard, a framework that decodes implicit cross-modal hazards in multimodal large language models via step-by-step risk attribution, and introduces TriggerBench, the first dataset explicitly modeling risk compositionality with counterfactual contrastive pairs, to address single-modality shortcut learning and hallucinated rationalizations in existing detection methods.
